title: Capstone: AI Evaluation Platform
description: Ship an evaluation platform for LLM/agent systems: versioned datasets → experiment runs → deterministic metrics → regression tests → reporting. Supports single-choice, rubric-graded, and pairwise comparisons, with experiment provenance stored so any historical number can be re-derived.
learningObjectives: Design versioned evaluation datasets with licenses and provenance
Run experiments with captured configs (model, params, prompt version)
Compute deterministic metrics where possible; grade rubrics transparently
Turn evaluation into regression tests and CI gates

milestones.title: Versioned datasets
milestones.objective: Create ≥2 evaluation datasets with versioning, license documentation, grading guidance, and per-item IDs.

milestones.title: Experiment runner
milestones.objective: Run evaluations capturing full provenance (model, params, prompt version, seeds) per item.
milestones.expectedOutput: Run records reproducible from config alone.

milestones.title: Metrics + comparisons
milestones.objective: Implement exact-match style metrics plus LLM-graded rubrics with documented prompts and human spot-checks.

milestones.title: Regression gate + report
milestones.objective: Convert metrics to CI regression tests with thresholds; produce a comparative report across ≥2 model or prompt versions.

categories.excellentExpectation: Full lineage from number → run → items
Agreement analysis between grader and human

architecture: datasets (versioned) → runner (captures provenance) → metrics → regression gate → reports
constraints: No metric without a stated failure mode
hints: Pairwise comparisons are seductive but statistically tricky; document ranking stability before claiming improvements
